question: My washing machine broke. A new one costs €600. Can I cover it?
title: When something breaks

cells.title: A must, tested against your account today
cells.code:
PENSION = (me.get("age") or 0) >= 68
PAY = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
PAY_TO = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
CYCLE = "pension cycle" if PENSION else "pay cycle"
def day(s):
    d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(s)[:10])
    return f"{d.day} {d:%b}"
emit("pay_word", PAY, "text", "The day money comes in")
emit("pay_to", PAY_TO, "text", "The day money comes in")

price = float(§PRICE§)
ITEM = "§ITEM§"
k = kori.breaks(price, ITEM)
res = k.get("reserve") or {}
parts = [{"label": "Your surprise reserve", "amount": res.get("used", 0.0)}, {"label": "Money this " + CYCLE + " does not need", "amount": res.get("from_buffer", 0.0)},
         {"label": "Safe to spend", "amount": res.get("from_safe_to_spend", 0.0)}]
ok = k["verdict"] in ("yes", "tight") and not k.get("partial_view") and res and abs(sum(p["amount"] for p in parts) - k["amount"]) < 0.005
if ok:                                            # it does not fit, or only part of the money is here: worked out fresh
    emit("price", k["amount"], "eur", "What it costs")
    emit("from_reserve", res["used"], "eur", parts[0]["label"])
    emit("from_buffer", res["from_buffer"], "eur", parts[1]["label"])
    emit("from_safe", res["from_safe_to_spend"], "eur", parts[2]["label"])
    emit("safe_before", k["safe"]["before"], "eur", "Safe to spend now")
    emit("safe_after", k["safe"]["after"], "eur", "Safe to spend after it")
    emit("per_day_after", k["per_day"]["after"], "eur_per_day", "Safe a day after it")
    emit("next_payday", k["next_payday"], "date", "Next payday")
    opt = next((o for o in k.get("options") or [] if o.get("text")), None)
    emit("plan", opt["text"] if opt else k["headline"], "text", "The plan to put it back")
    emit("has_plan", 1 if opt else 0, "count", "A plan to put it back")
    table("parts", parts, "Where the money comes from, in this order")
    text = f"Yes, you can cover {eur(k['amount'])} for {ITEM}: {eur(res['used'], True)} comes from your surprise reserve, set aside for this."
    if res["from_buffer"] > 0.005:                 # every pot that pays is named, so the sentence adds up to the price
        text += f" Another {eur(res['from_buffer'], True)} comes from money this {CYCLE} does not need."
    text += f" The last {eur(res['from_safe_to_spend'], True)} lowers safe to spend to **{eur(k['safe']['after'], True)}** until {PAY} on {day(k['next_payday'])}." if res["from_safe_to_spend"] > 0.005 else f" Safe to spend stays at **{eur(k['safe']['after'], True)}** until {PAY} on {day(k['next_payday'])}."
    say(text)
